listing.name: DoDonPachi (1997 World arcade) / omegakatana92 arcade-decomp recomp
listing.summary: Native recompilation of DoDonPachi for Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck using arcade-decomp. Features a retro frontend, keyboard and controller support, and AppImage packaging. Experimental build with ongoing audio and performance improvements. Requires your own legally obtained ROM; no game assets included.
